tool_arguments.query: Super Micro Computer AI server revenue Q1 fiscal 2027 quarterly net sales guidance

events.content: Super Micro Computer AI server revenue Q1 fiscal 2027 quarterly net sales guidance

Super Micro Computer’s quarter ended **September 30, 2025** was **Q1 fiscal 2026—not Q1 fiscal 2027**; the company reported total net sales of **$5.018 billion**. [[1]] 

Management said that **AI GPU platforms accounted for more than 75% of Q1 revenue**, implying AI-server/platform revenue of **more than approximately $3.76 billion** ($5.018 billion × 75%). [[2]] [[1]] 

This is an inferred lower bound rather than a separately disclosed “AI server revenue” line item: Supermicro’s reported financial statements disclose consolidated net sales, while the AI-platform figure was stated as a revenue mix percentage. [[1]] [[2]]

Sources:
[S1.1] Super Micro Computer, Inc. - Supermicro Announces First Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results — https://ir.supermicro.com/news/news-details/2025/Supermicro-Announces-First-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx
[S1.2] Super Micro Computer Inc (SMCI) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Navigating Challenges with AI ... — https://finance.yahoo.com/news/super-micro-computer-inc-smci-050939630.html
